 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    # identify compact colored object; all other marks are directional markers
    counts = {}
    for r,c in pts: counts[grid[r][c]] = counts.get(grid[r][c],0)+1
    color = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    obj = [(r,c) for r,c in pts if grid[r][c] == color]
    # find non-background connected component with most cells, as object
    unseen=set(pts); comps=[]
    while unseen:
        seed=unseen.pop(); comp={seed}; stack=[seed]
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop()
            for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if q in unseen: unseen.remove(q); comp.add(q); stack.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    obj=max(comps,key=len)
    # arrow markers are isolated colored pixels; copy the object toward each marker vector
    markers=[p for p in pts if p not in obj]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in markers:
        dr,dc=r-18,c-20 if w==21 else 0
    # For each marker, translated copies are indicated by marker position relative to object anchor.
    # derive anchor from the compact multi-color pattern's upper-left; markers specify shifts.
    return out
",

}
